actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The package's model is the MJCF scene xml/scene.xml, whose root element is '<mujoco model="jvrc1 scene">' and which includes jvrc1.xml
jvrc1.xml declares '<compiler angle="radian" meshdir="../meshes" texturedir="../meshes"/>', so the joint ranges are radians and its meshes and textures resolve from ../meshes
The model sets '<option timestep="0.001" iterations="50" tolerance="1e-10" solver="Newton" jacobian="dense" cone="pyramidal"/>', so its integration step is 0.001 s
The jvrc1 default class gives its joints limited="true" and damping="0.2" and its motors ctrllimited="false" forcelimited="false"
The robot's root body PELVIS_S is placed at pos="0 0 1.4" and has a freejoint named root
The R_HIP_P joint is a hinge with range -2.0944 to 0.785398 rad and armature 0.1925
The L_KNEE joint is a hinge with range 0 to 2.61799 rad and armature 0.1305
The contact section excludes adjacent pelvis, knee, waist, neck, shoulder, elbow and gripper body pairs from collision
Ten equality constraints couple the five distal finger joints of each hand to its thumb with polycoef values
The actuator section has one motor for each leg, waist, neck, shoulder, elbow, wrist and thumb joint, and no motor for the distal finger joints
The sensor section reads force and torque at both feet and both hands and a gyro and accelerometer at the imu site
The repository provides JVRC1 model files for MuJoCo and installs the files in the directory so that mc_mujoco can pick them up automatically
The CMake build sets JVRC1_XML_MODEL_PATH to xml/jvrc1.xml and JVRC1_PDGAINS_PATH to pdgains/PDgains_sim.dat
The mc_mujoco configuration template sets xmlModelPath and pdGainsPath to the installed model and PD-gains paths

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates one model deterministically from one initial state; the bridge takes no seed input and cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults, so a run repeats exactly on the same engine but no seed selects a different state.  The stand-in fake is deterministic in the same sense but is not MuJoCo.

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it reads the MJCF (scene.xml includes jvrc1.xml) for the joint dimensions and the actuator list but integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated joint toward its control target, so trajectories, contacts, actuator dynamics and the free-base dynamics are not MuJoCo's

the model's motors set ctrllimited=false and forcelimited=false (xml/jvrc1.xml:11-13), so the bridge publishes action.ctrl operator_required: a step that sets it is refused until the site's site-limits.json bounds it, and site-limits.example.json is operator example data, not a model bound
no mesh or texture is loaded and no contact, equality, tendon or sensor is resolved by the stand-in; the ten finger equality constraints of xml/jvrc1.xml:480-492 are not applied
MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine
no rendering is offered and no physical JVRC1 robot is modelled; nothing was validated against hardware

measures.description: Simulated time since the last reset
measures.name: time_ms

measures.description: Control vector last applied to the actuators (ctrl)
measures.name: ctrl

measures.description: Integration steps since the last reset
measures.name: tick

measures.description: Integration step of the model (null when the model states none)
measures.name: timestep_ms

measures.description: Seed the bridge was configured with
measures.name: seed

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.
measures.name: native_checkpoint

operator_required.name: step
operator_required.reason: the model gives none of its actuators no control range (ctrllimited false or no ctrlrange), so MuJoCo leaves the control unclamped; site-limits.json must bound action.ctrl before a step can set it

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the integration state is kept and stays readable
